# Agent marks

`rtMark` in `core/services/runtimes.js` displays the mark for a thread's runtime.
The artwork comes from LobeHub's `@lobehub/icons-static-svg` 1.104.0 (MIT).
The marks belong to their respective owners. [LobeHub Icons](https://lobehub.com/icons)

| Local file | Upstream file | Display |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `claude.svg` | `claude-color.svg` | Original orange |
| `openai.svg` | `openai.svg` | Monochrome mask |
| `antigravity.svg` | `antigravity-color.svg` | Original colors |
| `cursor.svg` | `cursor.svg` | Monochrome mask |
| `grok.svg` | `grok.svg` | Monochrome mask |

The standalone SVGs use 24×24 dimensions and omit inline styles and titles.
The element displaying each mark supplies its accessible name.
